packageRules.description: Wait for pnpm's one-day release hold before proposing npm updates
Review firmware upgrades before bundling them into server images

customManagers.description: Pin signed Rust OTA release tags and archive hashes together

transformTemplates: {"releases": $append([], $[draft = false and prerelease = false].($asset := assets[name = "weather-dash-rs-ota.tar" and state = "uploaded" and ($type(digest) = "string" ? $contains(digest, /^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/) : false)]; $count($asset) = 1 ? {"version": tag_name, "digest": $substring($asset.digest, 7)} : [])), "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/kruton/weather-dash-rs"}
